metadata.inputDescription: Three public photographed CORD receipts, plus a deliberately unexpected summary action. Authored workflows, not observed user behavior. Fixed 1500 ms review interval in both modes. Read-ahead OFF.
metadata.method: Actual provider-backed API. Fresh backend AI session/cache/seed model for each trial. OFF and ON use identical image inputs and scripts; ordinary caching enabled in both. Alternating paired order. Final background work drained for usage accounting. No artificial latency. Authored scenarios, not real-user prediction accuracy. Input provenance is specified separately in inputDescription.
